entities.summary: Éléonore Caroit is a French lawyer and politician who also holds Swiss and Dominican citizenship. A member of Renaissance (RE), she has been serving as Minister of State for Francophonie, International Partnerships and French Nationals Abroad in the government of Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu since 2025.
